dispositions.3662461f93288103a67b447e1f4e2c6754bf1768: The 1.5 FOSS migration retains ordinary platform prerequisites, signed installation, custom-path/PATH diagnosis, setup retry, managed-marker recovery and uninstall ownership guidance in docs/getting-started.md, docs/troubleshooting.md and docs/upgrade.md. It deliberately retires the optional paid-companion/activation sections, trial flags and Pro access-recovery instructions, the source-build feature restriction, and instructions to delete legacy Pro data. docs/managed-companion.md is now a compatibility link to the included Blame documentation. Current uninstall guidance preserves Core history, derived attribution data and legacy bytes/keys; old released uninstall behavior remains version-scoped. Current Core documents its compiled v2 feed. These reviewed product/doc changes explain the nonreversing hunks; they do not retire ordinary installer integrity or data-preservation behavior.

dispositions.fdea25e11cdda9bb500277be145574cb7033da04: Public C3 c3fbd8b4f06ad1e84c5fff7836602cc9f3b04249 retains the full durable-completion behavior, assertions, syscall, creation-race and terminal-durability tests from this 1.3.2 backport of 8541cbcef538d8f43c29a94859fcba4fe42bc494.
